findings.source_quality: A: merged upstream PR, code and author benchmarks
findings.evidence: Experimental meshopt_setAllocatorCache merged at 02:26 UTC. Author benchmark Windows 247 to 220 seconds and Linux 230 to 222 seconds for large cluster preprocessing, with 16 x 32 MiB blocks.
findings.limitation: Author-only benchmark, native processing not GPU runtime; cache API experimental and non-thread-safe to configure; up to 512 MiB pool; unproven on our workloads.
findings.implication: Add cache ON/OFF to pinned post-v1.3 arm. Measure wall time, RSS, page faults, allocation counts, geometry correctness, and keep runtime FPS separate.

findings.source_quality: A-: Centre de Recerca Matematica Catalan mathematical exhibition with scholarly bibliography, not primary archival record
findings.evidence: Newly surfaced October 1 exposition distinguishes polyfunicular load paths from definitive vault geometry. Gives catenary, ruled hyperboloid, and double-twist column mathematical teaching fixtures.
findings.limitation: Publication predates today; educational geometry does not certify historical dimensions or final design intent.
findings.implication: Keep separate provenance labels for force equilibrium, documented geometry, and creative reconstruction. Reject claims that equilibrium simulation alone proves definitive vault shape. Add explicit equation/load residual tests.
